title.value: A Double-oracle, Logic-based Benders decomposition approach to solve the K-adaptability problem
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly mentioned at the beginning, outlining the focus on a novel solution approach to the K-adaptability problem using a double-oracle and Logic-based Benders decomposition methodology.
title.quote: A Double-oracle, Logic-based Benders decomposition approach to solve the K-adaptability problem

extractions.description: The paper introduces a novel approach to solve K-adaptability problems by incorporating a logic-based Benders decomposition for the first-stage decisions and a double-oracle algorithm for the sub-problem. The method focuses on robust combinatorial optimization under uncertainty, involving integer decision variables and convex constraints. It operates by iteratively generating adverse scenarios and recourse decisions to converge on an optimal solution with finite iterations. The effectiveness of the algorithm is demonstrated through benchmark tests on adaptive combinatorial optimization problems.
